advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Decide whether the reconciler path should also receive the composed startup runtime for consistency with the worker path.
evidence: reconcile.py:359 `_voter.review_and_vote(ev, config=cfg, gerrit=gc, dedup=store)` — no runtime= argument
app.py:121 `asyncio.create_task(_worker(app.state.queue, cfg, runtime))` forwards runtime for the worker path
startup.py docstring: composed LLMRuntime is `the all-None ambient runtime, byte-identical to the RP-01 provider path` — makes the omission currently behavior-neutral
advisory.finding: The reconciler (backfill) path invokes review_and_vote without forwarding a runtime, so reconciler-driven reviews use the ambient runner while webhook-worker reviews use the composed startup runtime — an inconsistency in which auth/runtime path each review takes.
scenarios: If the composed runtime ever carries non-ambient (non-None) provider material, reconciler reviews would silently diverge from worker reviews.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] In the blank-token voter test, assert clone/provider work was skipped (e.g. g.get_patch_calls == 0) to lock the AC3 before-work ordering.
evidence: Test asserts only: `assert g.votes == []  # THE contract: no vote cast without decision auth` and `assert res["status"] != "voted"`
Contract in startup.py: 'the review-bot's decision-bearing Gerrit auth is validated BEFORE any job/provider work'
voter.py:451 places `_guard_decision_auth(cfg)` before `_extract`/clone, but no test asserts get_patch/clone were not called (FakeGerrit exposes `get_patch_calls`)
advisory.finding: The AC3 fail-closed guard's ordering contract ('validated BEFORE any dedup/clone/provider work; NEVER falls back') is only partially tested: the blank-token voter test asserts no vote is cast but never asserts that clone/provider work was skipped, so a regression that runs the review then discards the vote (or moves the guard after clone) would pass.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add `assert g.get_patch_calls == 0` (and, if reachable, that no clone occurred) to test_voter_casts_no_vote_when_decision_auth_is_blank.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that makes get_runner raise and asserts code_review_decision returns a fail-closed BLOCK (decision == 'BLOCK', review-error).
evidence: adapter.py:324-331: `if runtime is not None: try: ... runner = get_runner(...) except Exception ...: logger.warning('adapter: runner build failed: %s', exc); return _block('review-error', ...)`
search for 'runner build' in tests/unit returned no matching test for this path
New tests spy get_runner but never make it raise (test_rp04_s5_decision_auth_heldout.py:107-112)
adapter.py:322-323: '``runtime is None`` keeps the ambient path unchanged (runner stays None).' `runner = None`
test_rp04_s5_startup.py:94 passes `runtime=LLMRuntime()`; test_rp04_s5_decision_auth_heldout.py:124 passes `runtime=rt` — both non-None
search for 'request.runner' in tests/unit/test_review_bot.py returned no matches
advisory.finding: The new runner-build fail-closed BLOCK path in adapter.code_review_decision (get_runner raising -> return _block('review-error')) has no test.
merged_from: The ambient `runtime is None` branch (documented as 'runner stays None' / ambient path unchanged) is never asserted: both new adapter tests pass a real LLMRuntime, so no test verifies get_runner is NOT called and request.runner is None when runtime is None.
advisory.suggested_fix: Monkeypatch rebar.llm.runner.get_runner to raise, call code_review_decision with a runtime, and assert the returned decision is the fail-closed BLOCK/review-error shape.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Verify the adapter-built injected runner uses the gate's re-rooted cfg (or let the gate rebuild runtime-only), so pelt-mead-aeon's bare-clone failure cannot recur via request.runner.
evidence: gate_dispatch.py:477-479 `# Rebuild the runner from the RE-ROOTED cfg (bug pelt-mead-aeon): the preflight runner baked the pre-snapshot cfg; reusing it hits the bare clone (missing .tickets-tracker); injected kept.` … `runner_sel = request.runner or get_runner(cfg)`
runner.py:309 `cfg = _effective_config(self._config, req)` then runner.py:344-347 build filesystem/rebar tools over `cfg.repo_path` — i.e. the runner's own baked config root
dropped.finding: The adapter builds the injected runner from the PRE-SNAPSHOT cfg (LLMConfig.from_env(repo_root=repo_root)), but produce_code_review_verdict keeps an injected request.runner as-is (`request.runner or get_runner(cfg)`) and thus bypasses the re-rooted runner rebuild that bug pelt-mead-aeon explicitly added; the runner reads cfg.repo_path from its own baked config at run time, so a review may run its filesystem/ticket tools against the un-snapshotted clone root rather than the gate-resolved snapshot root.
scenarios: A code-review runs in attested/local gated mode where the gate re-roots cfg.repo_path to the snapshot/handle path different from the adapter's clone repo_root.
